name: instruxi
description: The Instruxi kit for Claude Code: Enforcer itself, its files, the Enforcer governor and the enforcer-graph planner, plus Jev hooks for Instruxi staff.

plugins.name: enforcer
plugins.description: Connects Claude Code to your Enforcer workspace: the enforcer MCP server, one sign-in (/enforcer:login) that every Instruxi plugin shares, and a short skill on how Enforcer is organised.

plugins.name: enforcer-governor
plugins.description: Decides whether an agent action is allowed before it runs, and keeps a tamper-evident record of every decision. Brings the enforcer MCP server.

plugins.name: jev-hooks
plugins.description: Instruxi staff only (private repo; installing needs instruxi-io access). Claude Code hooks backed by TypeSafe's Jev: a Bash and edit risk gate, subagent model routing, subagent verification, a stop self-check, loop detection and compaction triage.

plugins.name: enforcer-graph
plugins.description: Work a plan held in enforcer-graph: claim the next runnable node, keep its lease alive, and report against its acceptance criteria.

plugins.name: enforcer-files
plugins.description: Files in your Enforcer workspace: find, read and share them through the enforcer MCP server, and move the bytes with /enforcer-files:upload and /enforcer-files:download. Uses the enforcer plugin's sign-in.
